It has an embroidered design in the center depicting a tiered cake or stack of items. The neck closure appears to be a tie made of the same striped fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The embroidered cake/stack design lacks clear thread definition. It appears slightly 'melted' or smudged into the background fabric rather than sitting on top as distinct stitches. The shapes within the embroidery are somewhat ambiguous and lack sharp edges typical of real embroidery.

The ties at the neck appear to merge slightly with the collar trim without a clear knot or separation point. The fabric flow is slightly unnatural, suggesting a minor generation artifact in how the ties attach to the main body.
